implementation_boundary.supported_frontend_fixture: Explicit synthetic owner may close picker, update its own selected configuration, and reflect selection on reopen. Keep fixture mode and no connected service identifiable.
implementation_boundary.authority: Official UI selection expresses requested configuration. Effective tool execution permission belongs to the connected executor/service. This analysis does not prove that selecting Full Access grants remote or local OS permission.
implementation_boundary.failure: Do not report remote settings applied until an adapter has a matching acknowledgement. Official picker dismissal alone supplies no such acknowledgement.
implementation_boundary.layout: Existing v523 context-style-format findings locate permissionsControl in expanded toolbar. Ordinary compact branch does not consume configuration slots. No new compact special branch was proven here.
